overview.title: Thermal Vacuum Chamber Systems
overview.description: Deepvac develops standardised and custom-engineered thermal vacuum systems for aerospace qualification, environmental simulation, and research applications. Our chamber platforms address a range of test requirements, from established workflows using modular standard systems to fully bespoke configurations for complex mission profiles.

integrated.title: Beyond the Chamber
integrated.description: Deepvac provides engineering services across the full lifecycle, from control systems design and mechanical engineering to testing, retrofit, and subsystem integration.

items.q: What distinguishes a standard chamber from a custom configuration?
items.a: Standard Series chambers use pre-engineered designs with proven architectures, offering shorter lead times and established performance envelopes. Custom TVAC systems are engineered from concept to commissioning around application-specific requirements including geometry, thermal profile, instrumentation, and interface constraints.

items.q: Can standard chambers be modified for specific test requirements?
items.a: Standard Series platforms support a range of configuration options within their design envelope. For requirements beyond the standard platform scope, Deepvac offers custom engineering to develop application-specific solutions.

items.q: What support does Deepvac provide after chamber delivery?
items.a: Deepvac offers lifecycle services including preventive maintenance, repair, retrofit and modernisation, control system upgrades, and subsystem integration support for all chamber systems.

items.q: What is included in the scope of delivery of a chamber system?
items.a: A Deepvac chamber system is delivered as an operational complete system: vacuum chamber, pumping system, thermal system, control cabinet with in-house control software, and technical documentation. Commissioning and operator training are provided on site depending on the project. The binding scope of delivery is defined per project in the quotation.

items.q: Does Deepvac provide testing services alongside chamber systems?
items.a: Yes. Deepvac offers thermal vacuum testing services including test campaign execution, data acquisition, and engineering support for qualification, validation, and development programs.

standardSeries.title: Pre-Engineered TVAC Platforms
standardSeries.description: Standardised thermal vacuum chamber platforms with modular configurations and repeatable performance for aerospace qualification, environmental simulation, and research testing.

tSeries.title: T Series TVAC
tSeries.description: Compact cubic thermal vacuum chamber platforms designed for repeatable environmental simulation, subsystem validation, and laboratory workflows. The T Series combines controlled thermal and vacuum conditions with a standardised architecture for research and qualification applications.
tSeries.descriptionExtended: Its cubic geometry provides a flat base plate and maximized usable floor area — ideal for fixtures, optical benches, and fast integration of planar-mounted hardware. Standard configurations support vacuum performance down to {{vacuum}} and thermal operation down to {{minTemp}}, depending on the selected system setup.

features.label: Cubic Geometry
features.detail: Cube-based chamber layout for straightforward payload access, efficient internal volume usage, and flexible fixture integration.

features.label: Low Temperature Capability
features.detail: Configured for thermal operation down to {{minTemp}}, depending on system configuration and test setup.

features.label: Ultimate Vacuum
features.detail: Designed for vacuum performance down to {{vacuum}}, depending on chamber size and pumping package.

features.label: Control Integration
features.detail: Pre-engineered control system interface with data acquisition and automation support.

cSeries.title: C Series TVAC
cSeries.description: Cylindrical thermal vacuum chamber platforms designed for repeatable environmental simulation, subsystem qualification, and robust laboratory operation. The C Series combines controlled thermal and vacuum conditions with a standardised architecture for research and qualification applications.
cSeries.descriptionExtended: Its cylindrical geometry provides an inherently pressure-stable vessel with efficient, homogeneous shroud coverage — ideal for larger volumes and radiative thermal balance testing. Standard configurations support vacuum performance down to {{vacuum}} and thermal operation down to {{minTemp}}, depending on the selected system setup.

features.label: Cylindrical Geometry
features.detail: Cylindrical chamber layout suited for uniform radial design, efficient shroud integration, and classic vacuum chamber configurations.

features.label: Low Temperature Capability
features.detail: Configured for thermal operation down to {{minTemp}}, depending on system configuration and test setup.

features.label: Ultimate Vacuum
features.detail: Designed for vacuum performance down to {{vacuum}}, depending on chamber size and pumping package.

features.label: Control Integration
features.detail: Pre-engineered control system interface with data acquisition and automation support.

beyondStandard.title: Need a Custom Configuration?
beyondStandard.description: When test requirements exceed the standard platform scope, including non-standard geometries, specialised feedthrough configurations, application-specific thermal profiles, volumes below and above the standard series, or ultimate pressures down to the 10⁻⁷ mbar range, Deepvac offers fully custom-engineered TVAC solutions.

brochure.title: Deepvac Standard Series Catalogue
brochure.description: Explore the Deepvac Standard Series in more detail, including common technical characteristics, chamber configurations, control system features, and optional upgrades.

items.q: What chamber sizes are available in the Standard Series?
items.a: The Standard Series is available in both cubic and cylindrical chamber formats across a range of chamber volumes. Specific dimensions are selected according to the required test envelope, payload size, and integration needs.

items.q: What vacuum level can Standard Series chambers achieve?
items.a: Standard Series chambers are designed for vacuum performance down to {{vacuum}}, depending on chamber volume, pumping configuration, and application requirements.

items.q: What thermal control options are available?
items.a: Standard Series platforms include integrated thermal shroud and platen systems supporting controlled heating and cooling cycles. Minimum temperature capability can be configured down to {{minTemp}}, depending on the selected system configuration.

items.q: How are Standard Series chambers delivered and commissioned?
items.a: Deepvac provides full delivery, installation, and commissioning support including system integration, acceptance testing, and operator training.

items.q: Can the chambers reach pressures below 1 × 10⁻⁶ mbar?
items.a: Yes. The standard series is specified at ≤ 1 × 10⁻⁶ mbar, which covers most qualification workflows. For applications requiring lower ultimate pressures, configurations down to the 10⁻⁷ mbar range are available with adapted pumping systems — discussed individually per project.

items.q: When should I consider a custom TVAC system instead of a standard platform?
items.a: A custom configuration is appropriate when your test requirements include non-standard chamber dimensions, specific thermal profiles, complex feedthrough or instrumentation needs, contamination-sensitive hardware, or integration with existing facility infrastructure that exceeds the scope of standard platform options.

items.q: What information does Deepvac need to develop a custom system concept?
items.a: A productive initial discussion typically covers test article characteristics, required pressure and temperature ranges, thermal cycling requirements, feedthrough and instrumentation needs, facility constraints, and project timeline. Deepvac can guide this requirements definition process.

items.q: What is the typical timeline for a custom TVAC project?
items.a: Project timelines depend on system complexity, component lead times, and engineering scope. Deepvac provides project-specific timelines during the concept development phase.

items.q: Does Deepvac provide control systems for custom chambers?
items.a: Yes. Deepvac designs and integrates custom control architectures including automation logic, user interfaces, data acquisition, and instrumentation integration as part of the system delivery.

items.q: Can Deepvac integrate custom chambers with existing facility infrastructure?
items.a: Yes. Interface engineering and facility integration are core elements of Deepvac's custom chamber development process, including utility connections, safety systems, and control system interoperability.

items.q: What lifecycle support is available for custom systems?
items.a: Deepvac provides comprehensive lifecycle support including preventive maintenance, repair services, control system upgrades, retrofit and modernisation, and subsystem integration for all custom-engineered systems.

thermalVision.title: Deepvac Thermal Vision
thermalVision.heroDescription: Pressure-tight thermal camera integration for thermal vacuum chambers. Continuous infrared imaging under high-vacuum and extreme temperature conditions, with active thermal management, temperature stabilization of the camera, and full chamber integration engineering.
thermalVision.splitHeading: Integrated Thermal Imaging for TVAC Systems
thermalVision.bodyParagraph1: Commercially available infrared cameras cannot operate directly in high-vacuum and extreme-temperature environments without dedicated engineering measures. Deepvac Thermal Vision addresses this limitation through a pressure-tight enclosure with an IR-transparent viewport, enabling continuous, calibrated thermal imaging of test articles inside thermal vacuum chambers.
thermalVision.bodyParagraph2: The system includes an active temperature stabililization circuit that maintains the camera within its specified operating temperature range under all chamber conditions. Deepvac provides complete integration engineering, including enclosure design, thermal management, viewport specification, and mechanical interface design, for both new TVAC installations and retrofit of existing systems.

features.label: Pressure-Tight Camera Enclosure
features.detail: Sealed stainless-steel housing with IR-transparent viewport. Maintains atmospheric pressure around the camera sensor while the chamber operates under high vacuum.

features.label: Active Thermal Management
features.detail: Integrated cooling circuit with optional heating keeps the camera within its specified operating temperature range throughout chamber operation.

features.label: Stable Infrared Imaging
features.detail: Provides reliable and continuous thermal imaging under high-vacuum and extreme external temperature conditions by maintaining a controlled environment around the camera.

features.label: New Build & Retrofit Integration
features.detail: Mechanical and thermal interface engineering for integration into new TVAC installations or retrofit of existing thermal vacuum chambers. Single-source delivery.

options.title: Options
options.description: Every Deepvac chamber starts from a proven base configuration. Options extend it — or adapt the base itself — to match your exact test requirements. Some options add capability on top; others modify the underlying configuration.
options.note: Not every combination is available on every platform — we confirm feasibility during the technical clarification.

catalog.title: All options at a glance
catalog.hint: Select an option to open its detail page.

items.name: Solar Simulator
items.purpose: Replication of radiant solar heat loads
items.description: A solar simulator introduces a calibrated radiant flux into the chamber to replicate solar illumination in orbit. This extends test coverage to sun-facing operating cases and transient illumination scenarios.

items.name: Infrared Heaters
items.description: IR heater arrays apply an additional radiant heat load directly onto the test specimen. They enable faster temperature ramps and the simulation of radiative heating cases.

items.name: Additional Temperature Control Zones
items.description: Independently controlled thermal zones allow separate regulation of individual areas of the shroud or thermal plate. This improves uniformity and enables more complex temperature profiles.

items.name: Additional Temperature Sensors
items.description: Additional sensor channels increase the number of measurement points on specimen and shroud. Denser instrumentation improves temperature mapping and thermal model correlation.

items.name: Heated Chamber Walls (Bake-out)
items.purpose: Heating of the inner surfaces to accelerate outgassing
items.description: Integrated wall heating raises the temperature of the inner surfaces to accelerate outgassing of adsorbed water and contaminants. This shortens pump-down times and improves the achievable vacuum quality.

items.name: Cryogenic Traps
items.purpose: Condensation of water vapour and other condensable gases
items.description: Cryogenic traps condense water vapour and other condensable gases on cooled surfaces. This improves vacuum purity and pressure stability, particularly during long test campaigns.

items.name: Accelerated Pumping (Roots Booster)
items.description: A Roots booster added to the pumping train increases the effective pumping speed in the medium vacuum range. The result is a significantly reduced pump-down time.

items.name: Fully Oil-Free Vacuum Pumping
items.purpose: Pumping system equipped exclusively with dry pumps
items.description: The pumping system is equipped exclusively with dry pumps. This minimises the risk of hydrocarbon contamination of chamber and test specimen.

items.name: Automatic Venting & Purging with Dry Nitrogen
items.description: Automated venting and purge cycles with dry nitrogen ensure controlled repressurisation of the chamber. This reduces contamination risk and speeds up specimen changes.

items.name: Residual Gas Analysis (RGA)
items.purpose: Monitoring of the residual gas composition
items.description: A residual gas analyser monitors the composition of the residual gas in the chamber. This adds diagnostic depth to your tests — from leak signatures to outgassing behaviour.

items.name: QCM Monitoring
items.description: Quartz crystal microbalances monitor condensation and molecular contamination during the test. This enables a quantitative assessment of contamination levels.

items.name: Helium Leak Test Preparation
items.description: Dedicated connections prepare the chamber for helium leak testing. This accelerates acceptance testing and recurring tightness verification.

items.name: Viewing Window (optional ZnSe for Thermography)
items.purpose: Observation of the specimen; ZnSe for IR transmission
items.description: A vacuum-rated viewport allows direct observation of the test specimen during the test. With an optional ZnSe window, infrared radiation passes through the chamber wall — the basis for thermography and our {{link}} add-on.

items.name: Viewing Windows & Optical Connections
items.description: Additional viewports and optical feedthroughs enable visual inspection and optical measurements. Advanced diagnostics — without opening the chamber.
benefits: Advanced diagnostics without opening the chamber

items.name: Interior Camera
items.purpose: Video monitoring of the test specimen
items.description: A vacuum-compatible camera provides continuous video monitoring of the test specimen. This increases operational reliability and documentation quality.

items.name: Remote Monitoring & Advanced Data Logging
items.description: Network-based remote access and extended data logging with export functions. Full traceability and simplified evaluation of your test data.

items.name: Additional Process Connections
items.purpose: Vacuum feedthroughs for power, signals and sensors
items.description: Additional vacuum feedthroughs for power, signals and sensors simplify the integration of your test setup. Configured to your harness and interface requirements.

items.name: Vibration Isolation
items.description: Mechanical decoupling of the pumping system reduces vibration transfer to the chamber. Sensitive specimens remain undisturbed during the test.
benefits: Reduced vibrations at the test specimen

items.name: Water Cooling
items.description: Heat dissipation via water cooling instead of air cooling. This reduces heat emission into the lab and lowers the noise level.
